_comment: navya-1c-reasoning-v1: reasoning distillation of navya-1c-sft-dpo-grpo (1.31B). Teacher is a LOCAL deepseek-r1:14b (R1-Distill) over corpus_v2 prompts (code/13-reasoning/build_reasoning_traces.py); assistant target is '<think>reasoning</think>\n\nanswer' (code/13-reasoning/format_reasoning_sft.py). Small, purpose-built corpus (~300-400 conversations, data_dir reasoning_v1 — NOT sft_v9), so max_steps is modest and lr is lower than the original SFT pass (3e-5) to avoid wrecking post-training gains from DPO/GRPO while still teaching the <think> habit. Init from checkpoints/navya-1c-sft-dpo-grpo/ckpt_last.pt. Full fine-tune, same recipe as navya-1c-sft-v1 (fits comfortably on A100 40GB).
